ground_truth.description: run_verification() is an async function but the await keyword was removed. The variable 'verify' will be a coroutine object, not the result. All subsequent accesses to verify.passed, verify.lint_output, etc. will either AttributeError (coroutine has no 'passed' attribute) or always be truthy (coroutine object is truthy), producing incorrect metrics.
The new logging block accesses verify.passed etc. which will silently succeed if verify is a coroutine (coroutines are truthy), producing misleading log output rather than an error.

task.title: Log verification outcomes per eval task in collect_metrics
task.description: `orchestrator/src/orchestrator/evals/metrics.py::collect_metrics` re-runs verification for a completed workflow and folds the result into `EvalMetrics`, but the run log says nothing about what verification actually returned for a given eval task. When a cell scores `tests_pass=False`, an operator has to re-derive the reason from the worktree by hand. Emit one INFO log line just before the `EvalMetrics` is constructed, naming the task id, the tests/lint/typecheck outcomes and the plan-completion percentage. This is observability only: the metric fields and the values they carry must come out unchanged. Add a complexity `noqa` if the extra block pushes `collect_metrics` past the lint threshold.
task.test_strategy: Add a case to `orchestrator/tests/test_metrics.py` that drives `collect_metrics` over a stub workflow with `caplog` at INFO and asserts the emitted line carries the task id and the three verification outcomes it reports. Assert the returned `EvalMetrics` is unchanged from the pre-change result for the same stub, then run `ruff check orchestrator`.
